style: Photograph of a finished, museum-quality tabletop wargaming diorama, expertly hand-painted, on one continuous square sculpted base on a dark wooden plinth. Elevated three-quarter view from the front, about 35 degrees down, whole diorama in frame with a little margin, soft studio light, crisp focus everywhere. Extremely high detail. Miniature scale: the base is about 58 cm square, the mountain backdrop rises about 26 cm at the back, infantry figures are about 15 mm tall and fight in tight regiment blocks of 6 to 10 on small shared bases, giant eagles have about 12 cm wingspans and fly above on clear rods. Five clearly distinct armies, at least 20 figures each, every army readable at a glance by its colour and silhouette. Original fantasy design that does not depict any existing film, book or game: no famous characters, no recognisable landmarks, no text, no logos, no watermark.

themes.a-mountain-gate: Theme: the Battle Below the Mountain Gate. At the back a jagged snow-dusted mountain with a colossal carved stone gate between two weathered statues of armoured warrior-kings; a waterfall spills from one side. A valley runs forward from the gate between two rocky spurs. (1) A shield-wall of stocky bearded mountain warriors in heavy bronze armour with round shields and axes pours out of the gate. (2) Lean wood-elf spearmen and archers in green and gold leaf-patterned armour hold the left spur. (3) Human soldiers in blue tabards and kettle helms with long spears hold the right spur beside a burned lakeside town's ruined stone walls. (4) A huge horde of hunched, grey-skinned, wild-eyed goblins with crude spiked shields, jagged blades and tattered black banners charges up the valley floor from the front edge. (5) Four giant eagles swoop down from above the mountain onto the goblins. Smoke and dust rise from the fighting.
themes.b-ruined-valley: Theme: the Clash in the Ruined Valley. A rocky river valley with the shattered stone ruins of an old watchtower on a hill at the centre, a rope-and-timber bridge over the stream, and a cliff wall with a cave mouth at the back left. The five armies converge on the ruin from four sides: (1) bearded mountain warriors in bronze armour with axes and hammers form a wedge on the bridge; (2) wood elves in green and gold with bows and curved blades fire from the cliff top; (3) human soldiers in blue with spears and tower shields hold the ruined tower; (4) hordes of hunched grey-skinned goblins with crude spiked shields and black banners pour out of the cave mouth and down the slopes; (5) giant eagles dive onto the goblin column. Broken spears, fallen shields, scattered rocks and dust everywhere.
themes.c-frozen-pass: Theme: the Siege of the Frozen Pass. A narrow snowy mountain pass between two towering ice-streaked cliffs, with an ancient stone fortress wall and gatehouse across the pass at the back, and a frozen lake at the front right. (1) Bearded mountain warriors in bronze armour defend the wall and gatehouse with crossbows and axes. (2) Wood elves in green and silver with bows line a ledge on the left cliff. (3) Human soldiers in blue cloaks with spears and banners hold a barricade of carts and logs in the middle of the pass. (4) A vast horde of hunched grey-skinned goblins with spiked shields, ladders and a crude battering ram climbs the pass from the front and across the frozen lake. (5) Giant eagles burst through the clouds above the cliffs. Snow, smoke from braziers and churned ground.
